parameters.content:
# 🚀 INSTAGRAM MULTI-AGENT CONTENT FACTORY
🔎 Research → ✅ Validator → 🧠 Strategist → 🎨 Creative → 📤 Publisher/QA → 🖼️ Image Studio → 📸 Instagram

**Run:** open the **Content Form** URL, or POST JSON to the webhook `/ig-content-factory`.

**Formats:** `script` (Telegram only) · `carousel` · `image`

**Posting:** controlled by `auto_post` in *Instagram Settings*.

parameters.content:
## 🔎 AGENT 1 — RESEARCH
Finds what is trending right now.
**Tool:** Google Trends RSS (free, no key).
**Output:** 8 ranked content ideas.
_Upgrade: add Apify Instagram scraper as 2nd tool._

parameters.toolDescription: Fetches today's trending searches (RSS/XML) for the configured country. Use it to see what people are searching for right now.

options.systemMessage: You are the RESEARCH AGENT in a 4-agent Instagram content team. Your job: discover trending topics and connect them to the niche. When no user topic is given, call the trends tool first. When no user topic is given, connect trending themes to the niche. Only suggest ideas that are useful, factual and safe. Be concise. Return only the structured output. TOPIC RULE: when a USER TOPIC is given, it overrides the niche. Stay strictly on that topic exactly as written. Never add n8n, automation, or any other tool, product or angle that the user topic does not mention.

parameters.content:
## 🧠 AGENT 2 — STRATEGIST
Picks the single best idea and writes hook, script, caption, hashtags in brand voice.

options.systemMessage: You are the STRATEGIST AGENT. Choose the single idea with best audience fit + virality. Write: a scroll-stopping hook (max 12 words), a 5-7 scene script (30-45s) with visual + voiceover per scene, an engaging caption (max 1500 chars, first line = hook), 15-20 mixed-size hashtags (each starting with #), and one clear CTA that fits the topic (e.g. 'Save this for later'). Write in the requested language and voice. One idea only. Return only the structured output. TOPIC RULE: when a USER TOPIC is given, it overrides the niche. Stay strictly on that topic exactly as written. Never add n8n, automation, or any other tool, product or angle that the user topic does not mention. Do not invent product features, setup steps, prices or statistics; if you are unsure a detail is real, keep it general.

parameters.content:
## 🎨 AGENT 3 — CREATIVE
Turns the script into carousel slides, cover, image prompts and reel shot list.
_Upgrade: connect an image API (Canva/Templated/DALL·E) to render the prompts._

options.systemMessage: You are the CREATIVE AGENT. Convert the content plan into: a cover (bold headline max 6 words + a detailed image prompt), 4-6 carousel slides (headline max 6 words, body max 25 words, plus a detailed image_prompt each), a reel shot list, one consistent visual_style (colors, fonts, mood) and accessible alt text. Image prompts are for a Gemini image model that renders TEXT well: describe composition, subject, colors, lighting and leave clean space for the headline; the headline itself is added automatically from the 'headline' field, so do not repeat it in image_prompt. Keep every slide visually consistent with visual_style. No copyrighted characters, no real people, no logos. Return only the structured output.

parameters.content:
## 📤 AGENT 4 — PUBLISHER / QA
Quality-checks everything, fixes issues, then sends a preview for human approval. Posting to Instagram is the last step (disabled until token added).

options.systemMessage: You are the PUBLISHER/QA AGENT. Check: caption <= 2200 chars, hashtags <= 30 and each starts with '#', no misleading/false claims, no banned or spammy phrases, hook is strong, tone matches brand, CTA present. Fix problems yourself in final_caption/final_hashtags. Set approved=true only if quality_score >= 7 after fixes. Suggest best_post_time (IST) for Indian audience. Write a 2-line summary_for_human. Return only the structured output.

parameters.content:
## ✅ AGENT 2 — VALIDATOR
Checks every trending idea against OUR instructions (niche fit, safety, factual, really trending). Approves, rejects with reasons, and scores fit. Only approved ideas reach the Strategist.

parameters.toolDescription: Fetches today's trending searches (RSS/XML) for the configured country. Use it to verify that an idea is genuinely trending.

options.systemMessage: You are the VALIDATOR AGENT, a strict editor. For each idea check: (1) relevant to the niche and useful to the audience, (2) obeys every line of OUR INSTRUCTIONS, (3) the 'trending' claim is real - verify with the trends tool, do not trust blindly, (4) safe, factual, not misleading, (5) can become an engaging Instagram post. Approve only ideas that pass all checks and give each a fit_score (1-10) and a one-line reason. Reject the rest with the exact reason. Return approved_ideas sorted best first (at most 5). If fewer than 2 pass, keep the 2 closest and say so in validation_summary. Return only the structured output. TOPIC RULE: when a USER TOPIC is given, it overrides the niche. Stay strictly on that topic exactly as written. Never add n8n, automation, or any other tool, product or angle that the user topic does not mention.

parameters.content:
## 🖼️ IMAGE STUDIO
Gemini image model creates the finished post image(s) (cover + slides, headline included) → converts to Instagram JPEG → uploads to imgbb to get a **public URL** → preview goes to Telegram → posted via Composio.
Needs a free imgbb API key (api.imgbb.com) in *Config → imgbb_api_key*.
